changelog: 🎙️ Phase 22: Antigravity Live Duplex Voice Call & Native Rust Audio Pipeline.
🗣️ Live Duplex Voice Calls: Real-time speech interaction with Antigravity agents backed by Voice.proto and background microphone service.
🎭 Agent Voice Picker: Interactive voice preview dialog with live orb animation and voice sample playback.
📜 Live Transcripts & Diagnostics: Real-time call transcription sheet and hub diagnostic log capture (/api/agy/hub/diag) for failed calls.
🦀 Pure Rust Audio DSP: Native VAD, Cooley-Tukey FFT, SNR analysis, and spectral equalizer in agy_ide_bridge_rs and antibot_native.
